defs.def: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold 温暖的；暖和的

ex.s: One probable reason is that most climate models assume that the melting of permafrost is driven only by warming air.

ex.s: It tells the heart-warming story of three children and the healing power of the secret garden.

ex.s: With millions of people likely to take on DIY projects over that coming weeks, new research shows that more than half of people are planning to make the most of the long, warm summer days to get jobs done.
ex.t: 数以百万计的人可能在接下来的几周里动手做DIY项目，新的研究显示，超过一半的人打算利用漫长而温暖的夏日把活干完。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日那天我们收集物品的所有努力终于汇聚在一起．当我看到我们收集的各种物资时我突然意识到我们当天要制作的每一个包裹最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中．在过去四个月里我从没想过项目完成后我会是什么感觉．在制作包裹的过程中我意识到我已经忘记了它背后的真正意义．我只把它当作又一个学校项目而且我想在这个项目上取得好成绩．当包裹完成准备运往海外时那种温暖的感觉是我永远不会忘记的．

ex.s: He got up and shook Vinnie's hand warmly, “I've heard that you are a talented young woman, and I have found you charming and intelligent as well.
ex.t: 他站起来热情地握住Vinnie的手："我听说你是一位有才华的年轻女子，我也发现你既迷人又聪明。"

ex.s: It's still a little too cold for them to go out into the open, but as soon as the weather warms up, I have no doubt that the little one will be out and about exploring and playing every day.”
ex.t: 天气还有点冷不适合外出，但我毫不怀疑这小家伙很快就会每天出去探索和玩耍。"

ex.t: 相反，它们在更温暖的室内长得更好

ex.t: 在中国，它在天气较暖的月份栖息于东北的河流和湿地。

defs.def: keeping you warm or staying warm in cold weather 保暖的；保温的

defs.def: 即将猜中；接近答案；即将找到

ex.s: To try a new way to warm up the coming lecture.

defs.def: to make sth/sb warm or warmer; to become warm or warmer （使）温暖，变暖和

ex.s: Eventually, researchers made a prediction that progressive warming during the 21st and 22nd centuries would dry out the Arctic, and lakes would begin to shrink.
ex.t: 最终，研究人员预测，21和22世纪的持续变暖会使北极变干，湖泊开始萎缩。

ex.s: But phytoplankton are vulnerable to the ocean's warming trend.
ex.t: 但浮游植物容易受到海洋变暖趋势的影响。

ex.s: Warming changes key characteristics of the ocean and can affect phytoplankton growth，since they need not only sunlight and carbon dioxide to grow，but also nutrients.
ex.t: 变暖改变了海洋的关键特征，并会影响浮游植物生长，因为它们生长不仅需要阳光和二氧化碳，还需要营养物。

ex.s: Warming will overtake them.
ex.t: 变暖终将超过它们。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部，温室（将光线反射回太空）的突然增加已经改变了当地的变暖趋势，实际上使该地区降温了。

ex.s: By painting buildings white, cities may slow down the warming process.
ex.t: 通过将建筑物漆成白色，城市可能会减缓变暖过程。

ex.t: 全球变暖影响适应形式D. 适应气候变化具有挑战性

ex.t: 全球变暖趋势无法阻止。

ex.t: 阳光反射可能缓解全球变暖。

ex.s: When life seems like one long night,And nothing is ever going right,There's just one sure delight:Friendship, like sunrise, warm and bright.
ex.t: 当生活仿佛漫漫长夜，事事皆不如意，唯有一样确凿的欢愉：友谊，如旭日，温暖而明亮。

ex.s: For instance, you might hear someone say: “It’s cold this winter, so I needn’t worry about global warming.”Another is that loud and urgent matters are given too much importance, making people ignore longer-term trends that arguably matter more.
ex.t: 例如，你可能听到有人说："今年冬天很冷，所以我不必担心全球变暖。"另一个原因是，响亮而紧急的事情被赋予了太多重要性，使人们忽略了那些可以说更重要的长期趋势。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 已经受到气候变暖威胁的雪，会随着气温升高从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变其清冷洁净的气味。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

defs.def: to become more friendly, loving, etc; to make sb feel or become more friendly, loving, etc. （使）变得更友好，变得更温情

ex.s: Snow is intensified by a warming climate.
ex.t: 雪因气候变暖而变得更为显著。

ex.s: By the end of the century，if not sooner，the world's oceans will be bluer and greener thanks to a warming climate，according to a new study.
ex.t: 一项新研究显示，到本世纪末（甚至更早），由于气候变暖，世界海洋将变得更蓝更绿。

ex.s: But in some waters，such as those of the Arctic，a warming will make conditions riper for phytoplankton，and these areas will turn greener.
ex.t: 但在某些水域，如北冰洋，变暖将使浮游植物生长的条件更加成熟，这些区域将变得更绿。

defs.def: to prepare for physical exercise or a performance by doing gentle exercises or practice （为体育活动或表演）做适应性练习，做准备活动；热身

ex.t: 经过数月的准备，我开始了我伟大的___14___登山之旅。在山脚下，我遇到了米克，一位当地向导，他热情地___15___迎接了我。

ex.s: After some wild warm up, I charged into the lake along with others.
ex.t: 经过一番疯狂的热身活动后，我和其他人一起冲进了湖里。

ex.s: She regretted not doing enough warm up.
ex.t: 她后悔没有做足够的热身运动。

defs.def: to run for a short time in order to reach the temperature at which it will operate well 机器、发动机等

ex.s: To stay warm, she ran her engine for a few minutes every now and then.
ex.t: 为了保暖，她时不时让发动机运转几分钟。
